prompt: Create a vertical fantasy achievement artwork for Worldwalker: a lone hooded traveler stands at the center of an ancient circular stone nexus, viewed from a slightly elevated cinematic angle. Use intricate environmental detail, floating debris, fractured stone, magical particles, atmospheric fog, volumetric light, painterly concept-art rendering, high contrast, sharp silhouettes, and a premium game achievement badge feel. No readable text, no UI frame, no logo, no watermark.
